observations.ap_rule: cut depth per pass = cutting edge diameter (1xD); 2xD reduce chip load 25%; 3xD reduce chip load 50%
observations.source_page: sources/onsrud_soft_plywood_cutting_data.txt line 27, row "48-000 1xD", 5/8 in column: .008-.010 in/tooth (column by character position, offset 1.0)
observations.notes: Feeds contract P24a (2026-11-10). Transcribed by script from the stored text; the cell is matched to the nearest diameter header by character position. The 48-000 series is "Two Flute - Carbide Tipped Straight" (sources/onsrud_pct19_catalog.txt, page 36, which also lists a two-flute part at this diameter), so the row is of the straight series (`feeds::series`): only a straight-flute tool reads it. The sheet's Application table does not name the series and the chart names no operation, so the row sits under (pocket, roughing), the home of a chart that names no operation (G3).
